question: Why is Shiva said to have manifold forms in the scriptures?
premises: Shiva has the universe as his form.
As such, he manifests the variety of conscious and unconscious things.
Scriptures like the Dikshottara state his manifold formhood.
inference: Shiva is described as manifold because his universal form appears as the diverse conscious and unconscious world.
plain_english: Because Shiva takes the universe as his form, he appears as the full variety of conscious and unconscious things. For this reason, texts such as the Dikshottara say that he has many forms.
